name: Sub Kategorie
description: One row per subcategory (e.g. Chandeliers -> wall-mounted/ceiling-mounted/floor-standing), scoped to its parent Produkte Kategorie via `kategorie`. Text-only (no image) — used purely to drive the subCategory filter on /produkte/shop/[category] (src/lib/api/fetchSubKategorien.js), never shown as its own tile.

fields.label: Category Key
fields.description: Unique subcategory key, conventionally "<parent category_key>--<subtype>" (e.g. "chandeliers--wall-mounted") since subtype words repeat across different parents (round, wall-mounted, extendable, ...).

fields.label: Parent Category
fields.description: Which of the 32 main categories this subcategory belongs to. Every list/filter query scopes by this field.
